description: Ministry of Higher Education and Cultural Affairs -  Notify the Order of appointment that Prof. Prishantha Gunawardhana  to be the Competent Authority for the Postgraduate Institute of Archeology, w.e.f. 24.01.2018
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (Dr. Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, Minister of Higher Education and Cultural Affairs) and also outlines the detailed responsibilities being assigned to another named individual (Professor Prishantha Gunawardhana as Competent Authority) to exercise powers in lieu of the Director of the Postgraduate Institute of Archeology. It contains both "who" (government personnel) and "what" (detailed responsibilities and functions), making it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
